tx_pending.meaning: the submitted transaction is not mined immediately and remains pending

executed_after_deadline.meaning: the pending transaction is executed at a later time after its intended deadline

claims.scope: L2TokenReceiverV2::increaseLiquidityCurrentRange interacting with Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager using block.timestamp as deadline

preconditions.text: A transaction with insufficient gas may not be mined immediately and remains pending.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The deadline argument passed to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager should enforce a real expiry so a transaction cannot be executed after its intended deadline.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Pending transactions without a proper deadline can be executed maliciously at a later time.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The deadline argument is intended to bound the time window in which the transaction may be executed.
The delayed execution harm is stated as a possibility, not an observed event.

limitations: No concrete transaction, actor, or observed execution is reported; the harm is only potential.
The plan formalizes only the delayed_execution impact; mev_disadvantage is not covered here.
